evidence: Graesse, Orbis Latinus s.v. Luciliburgum: Luciliburgum, Luceburgium, Lucem-, Luxem-, Lutzemburgum … Augusta Romanduorum, Luxemburg
terms.comment: The country and its capital have one name. The country takes a preposition (in Lucemburgum); the town takes none (Lucemburgī, in Luxembourg).
